get.description: Retrieve a list of sequences for a specified user in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter sequences by user ID and optionally paginate through results using a cursor. It is useful for managing and reviewing sequences associated with a particular user.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user whose sequences are to be retrieved. This parameter is required.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token for pagination. Use the value from the previous response's paging.next.after field to get the next set of results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

post.description: Enroll a contact into a sequence using the specified sequence ID. This operation requires the user ID to be provided as a query parameter. The request body must include the contact ID, sender email, and sequence ID. This endpoint is useful for automating the enrollment of contacts into predefined sequences for streamlined communication and follow-up processes.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user performing the enrollment. This parameter is required.

get.description: Retrieve the sequence enrollment details for a specific contact in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides information about the sequence a contact is enrolled in, including enrollment dates and the sequence's name and ID.

parameters.name: contactId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the contact whose sequence enrollment details are being retrieved.

post.description: Enroll a service account into a sequence using the specified enrollment details. This endpoint is useful for automating the process of adding service accounts to sequences, which can help streamline workflows and ensure consistent engagement strategies. Please note: the scopes for this endpoint requires user-level access and will not work for existing apps with portal-level access.

get.description: Retrieve a list of sequences available in the service account. This endpoint supports pagination and allows filtering by sequence name. It is useful for obtaining an overview of sequences for management or reporting purposes. Please note: the scopes for this endpoint requires user-level access and will not work for existing apps with portal-level access.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

post.description: Create a new sequence in your HubSpot account using the specified settings and steps. This endpoint allows you to define the sequence's properties, such as its name, settings, steps, and dependencies, to automate processes effectively. Please note: the scopes for this endpoint requires user-level access and will not work for existing apps with portal-level access.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific sequence in your HubSpot account using the sequence ID. This endpoint provides comprehensive information about the sequence, including its settings, steps, and dependencies. It is useful for obtaining sequence configurations and understanding the sequence's structure and components. Please note: the scopes for this endpoint requires user-level access and will not work for existing apps with portal-level access.

parameters.name: sequenceId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the sequence to retrieve.

put.description: Update an existing sequence in your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows you to modify the sequence settings, steps, and dependencies. Ensure that the sequenceId provided in the path is valid and corresponds to the sequence you wish to update. Please note: the scopes for this endpoint requires user-level access and will not work for existing apps with portal-level access.

parameters.name: sequenceId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the sequence to update.

delete.description: Delete a specific sequence in your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This operation will remove the sequence and can optionally override active enrollments if specified. Please note: the scopes for this endpoint requires user-level access and will not work for existing apps with portal-level access.

parameters.name: sequenceId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the sequence to delete.

parameters.name: overrideActiveEnrollment
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether to override active enrollments when deleting the sequence.

get.description: Retrieve the performance metrics of a specific sequence in your HubSpot account. This endpoint provides detailed insights into the sequence's effectiveness, including metrics such as opened, clicked, and replied rates. It is useful for analyzing the success of your sequences over time. Please note: the scopes for this endpoint requires user-level access and will not work for existing apps with portal-level access.

parameters.name: sequenceId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the sequence to retrieve performance metrics for.

parameters.name: timelineInterval
parameters.description: The interval for the timeline data. Defaults to 'WEEK'.

get.description: Retrieve details of a specific sequence in your HubSpot account using its unique identifier. This endpoint requires specifying the sequence ID and the user ID associated with the sequence. It is useful for accessing detailed information about a sequence's configuration and status. Please note: the scopes for this endpoint requires user-level access and will not work for existing apps with portal-level access.
